items.headline: Responsible Use of AI in Consulting: What IMC USA's AI Code Means for You
items.summary: Imagine this: It's Friday evening, and a client report is due Monday. Dana uses an AI tool to draft a market analysis. The result is clean, confident and well organized.

items.headline: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
items.summary: Men's employment grew faster than women's in occupations most exposed to AI, a gap driven largely by workers without a bachelor's degree.

items.headline: New AI shopping agents promise better bargains. But who pays the price?
items.summary: As AI agents begin shopping on our behalf, there's a real risk cheaper products could put more pressure on vulnerable workers in global supply chains.

items.headline: What is it like to work when your co-workers are AI agents?
items.summary: Using AI for roles from executive assistants to chiefs of staff, companies are boasting about doing more with less, creating tension with their human workers

items.headline: AI bots flooded 2023 UK government consultation on disposable vapes ban
items.summary: Three-quarters of all responses were machine-generated in failed attempt to stop bill from passing into law, research finds

items.headline: After a year of uncertainty, Job Corps is making a comeback
items.summary: Last year, President Trump ordered more than 100 Job Corps training programs to close to save federal funds. A lawsuit stopped that, and now enrollment is up for "AI-proof" trade career training.
